== Czech Quake Events ==
Later known as: Czech QuakeWorld Events

Link: http://cqe.rytir.com/

Tournament series for Czech (and Slovak) QuakeWorld players, founded in December 2002 by [[JohnNy_cz]] with assistence of [[Goodman]]. Later co-administration done by [[moris]].

== Seasons ==

 * 2nd: [[moris]]
 * 3rd: [[Flamer]]
